title: Inductions for Sophomores
description: An induction event for sophomores seeking selection into The Robotics Club Pantnagar and an opportunity to learn about the club's robotics activities.
longDescription: Inductions for Sophomores is the selection event for students who want to join The Robotics Club Pantnagar. It introduces candidates to the club's vision, members, technical projects, events, and opportunities to contribute to its robotics activities.
rules: The induction process will be conducted in two phases: an aptitude test followed by an interview.
Phase 1: The aptitude test will be conducted only on September 14, 2026, and will last approximately 30 to 45 minutes. The final duration will be announced separately.
The aptitude test is optional and is not required to participate in the interview; participants who take it may receive additional points.
Phase 2: Interviews will be conducted on September 15 and 16, 2026.
All participants may attend the interview, regardless of whether they took the aptitude test.
During the interview, a panel of judges will ask questions based on the candidate's resume and award points according to the quality of their answers.
Participants are expected to arrive on time for their scheduled session.
Please bring an up-to-date resume for the induction process.
